scope: Actual pinned old Go LINK Fragmenter/Reassembler and FEC FastBlockEncoder first systematic source/partial parity headers + Rust pure wire schema/MTU. No Rust GF coding, recovery, scheduling or production network.

observations.link: Original Go fragmentation at LINK MTU64 keeps len63,64 unwrapped and splits len65 into two 20B-header frames (44+21B payload) with same packetID. WBDLFRG1 prefix escapes; adaptive FEC-off 'WF' escapes; fixed off keeps WF unchanged.
observations.fec: Original Go FastBlockEncoderWithParity using actual ReedSolomon20x20 emits systematic first source with 56B header flag1 and configured 20:4 parity count, dataCount placeholder20, own original length3; k1 Flush emits one final parity shard with header flag0, dataCount1 and parity profile4. Six supported 20:R profile control headers validated by Go tests; no parity payload bytes fixture.
observations.rust: Rust pure wire module validates fixed LINK20B, FEC56B explicit big-endian offsets, MTU±1, 65535 logical length, truncated/invalid/profile/flags, and mode-specific magic/WF escape. Output is opaque borrowed or copied wire, no business delivery.
